opportunities.title: Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
opportunities.description: Official MIT Office of Graduate Education listings for Electrical Engineering and Computer Science state that doctoral applications open 15 September and the deadline is 1 December at 11:59 PM Eastern Time. Degrees listed are Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) and Doctor of Science. Official note: a Master of Science degree is required of students pursuing a doctoral degree; if you do not have a master's when you apply, you receive that degree first before proceeding to the Ph.D. A terminal master's degree is not offered.
opportunities.eligibility: Official OGE materials describe Ph.D. and Sc.D. study in EECS. A master's is required of doctoral students; applicants without a master's receive that degree first. A terminal master's is not offered.
